facts.business: Muthoot Microfin Limited is a non-deposit taking non-banking financial company (NBFC) primarily engaged in microfinance lending to underserved communities in India.
key_risks: Forward-looking statements subject to assumptions, risks and uncertainties that may cause actual results to differ materially
Asset quality risks with loans overdue or repaid with delay
Regulatory compliance risks as NBFC registered with RBI
facts.related_party_note: During the year, the Company has not provided guarantee/security to companies, firms, limited liability partnerships and other parties. During the year, in the ordinary course of its business, the Company has made investments, granted loans and advances in the nature of loans, unsecured, to companies, firms, limited liability partnerships and other parties.
